metadata.methods_description: Participants were implanted with clinical surface (grid) and depth electrodes, with two patients additionally receiving a high-density research grid. Patients viewed grayscale pattern stimuli varying in spatial/temporal properties or color images of six stimulus categories while performing a fixation task with a color-change detection component. Pre-implantation T1 MRI scans were collected for electrode localization. Data were preprocessed into common-average-referenced voltage data and broadband power envelopes, with additional derivatives including epoched trials, freesurfer surface reconstructions, and model fits.
